beats.text: They built a *fire* to burn him…
beats.sub: Then Allah gave it one command.

beats.text: Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) broke their *idols.* His people were furious.
They built a *huge fire*… and threw him into it.
Then Allah gave the fire *one command.*

beats.arabic: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
beats.translation: “O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham [Ibrahim].”

beats.text: The fire obeyed its *Creator.* It could not harm him.
When Allah is with you, *no fire* is stronger.
Follow for more stories of the prophets.
